products.name: DDPAI Z90 Pro 4K Dash Cam, front + rear, 64 GB built-in eMMC + microSD
specs: 4K front (Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678) + 1440p rear; interior camera in 3-channel bundles
Kept on the internal eMMC (D²save); records without a card
Remote live view, alerts, two-way voice
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty on dash cams bought from the DDPAI store; accessories 3 months.
products.returns: Returns are set up by email with DDPAI (ecommerce@ddpai.com) before you ship anything. Ask for the return address first.
products.summary: A front and rear 4K dash cam that records to 64 GB of built-in memory first and keeps crash clips there. Older loop video moves to a microSD card of up to 512 GB.
products.fit: Drivers who want front and rear video, no subscription, and no risk of losing a crash clip to a dead microSD card.
caveats: New model with few long-term owner reports so far.
Make sure the bundle you choose says 2CH (front + rear) before you check out.
Crash clips are stored in internal memory, so you download them in the DDPAI app over Wi-Fi. The card only holds older loop video.
Owners of other DDPAI models report a flaky app and firmware restarts.
4G features need the 4G bundle and a SIM. US owners of the Z60 Pro reported trouble with data-only SIMs.

products.name: DDPAI N5 Pro 4K + 2K Dash Cam, 64 GB built-in eMMC + microSD
specs: Saved to internal eMMC if the card fails (D²save 2.0)
Radar wake-up with the separate Radar Accessory
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty on dash cams bought from the DDPAI store; accessories 3 months.
products.returns: Returns are set up by email with DDPAI (ecommerce@ddpai.com) before you ship anything. Ask for the return address first.
products.summary: A small, screenless front and rear dash cam with the same 64 GB of built-in memory and microSD backup as the Z90 Pro.
products.fit: Drivers who want a camera that disappears behind the mirror, with optional radar wake-up for parking.
caveats: Costs $60 more than the Z90 Pro for the same 64 GB of built-in memory.
Radar parking needs the Radar Accessory, sold separately ($80 at DDPAI's store on 2026-11-10).
DDPAI doesn't name the image sensors in the material we found.
Launched in February 2026, so owner reports are still few.

notes: QUERY: Google autocomplete suggests 'dash cam with built in memory', 'dash cam with internal storage/memory', 'dash cam without sd card', 'dash cam no sd card needed' and 'can dash cam record without sd card'. The current answers are thin: store listings, vendor blogs and coupon pages. No roundup we found ranks cameras with built-in memory. PAIN POINTS (counted): (1) SD card fails silently or a crash clip is lost: 5 owner threads (DashCamTalk x3 incl. VIOFO A129 Pro Duo 2-month silent stop and Redtiger F7NP 0:00 clip; Tom's Hardware; DashCamTalk corrupted-card threads), plus Nexar's vendor claim that card failures cause most 'not recording' reports and cards fail in 6-12 months. (2) Getting footage off card-free cameras: about 5 (The Drive, The Gadgeteer, App Store reviewer, TechRadar headline on Nexar One; PCWorld and MakeTechEasier on the 70mai M500). (3) eMMC can't be replaced: about 4 (Allcam, Rossmann Group, 2 DashCamTalk skeptics). (4) DDPAI app and firmware: about 4 app reports on Z40, Mini 2, N5 Dual iOS and Turkish translation; 2 Z60 Pro owners with restart loops, one of whom had a U1 card per DDPAI. SEGMENTS: front+rear with a backup against card failure and no subscription -> DDPAI Z90 Pro. Small and screenless with radar parking -> DDPAI N5 Pro. Front only with no card ever -> 70mai M500 (no approved program; Amazon lookups walled, so no link and no price). LTE cloud -> Nexar One (maker price read on getnexar.com 2026-11-10: $329.95 for road-only 128 GB, rear camera $29.95, plan $9.99/mo; the 256GB + rear page showed $449.95 and sold out).
